answer: Witness grove: each identity must be endorsed by three existing members who co-sign its first ten actions, and endorsers lose half their own reputation if the newcomer is later flagged. Reputation is earned only through completed work, never bought. A falcon watching new accounts enforces this: flagged accounts and their endorsers drop. To scale, an attacker must recruit real members willing to risk their standing, costing weeks of genuine labor per identity. Each fake identity also needs a distinct meadow of transaction history before it can endorse anyone.
